text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, pardon me. My apologies. Um, this 
is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Grooming my tail before bed, it just 
wouldn't go well last night."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
By the time it was finished to my 
satisfaction— I had gone way, way past my 
scheduled bedtime...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Eishin Flash wasn't able to rest 
much...
